# Sprunki Pyramixed

> Sprunki Pyramixed is a collection of free browser-based music creation and rhythm games featuring drag-and-drop gameplay, character customization, and creative sound layering.

The site hosts multiple Sprunki game variations and mods, each offering unique themes and gameplay mechanics for music creation. All games are playable directly in the browser without downloads, making them accessible for casual players and music enthusiasts alike.

- Sprunki Pyramixed

## Main Games

- [Sprunki Pyramixed](https://pyramixed.org): Main homepage for Sprunki Pyramixed music creation rhythm game
- [Sprunki Pyramixed Mod](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-pyramixed-mod): Sprunki Pyramixed Mod with Egyptian theme music creation gameplay
- [Sprunki Pyramid](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-pyramid): Sprunki Pyramid music creation game with character customization
- [Sprunki Pyramixed 0.9](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-pyramixed-0-9): Sprunki Pyramixed 0.9 music creation game with character arrangement
- [Sprunki Pyramix](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-pyramix): Sprunki Pyramix ancient Egypt-themed music creation game

## Game Variations & Mods

- [Sprunki Phase 1.7](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-phase-1-7): Sprunki Phase 1.7 rhythm game blending music with horror elements
- [Sprunki Pyraminx](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-pyraminx): Sprunki Pyraminx music-mixing game with rhythm and creativity focus
- [Sprunki Human](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-human): Sprunki Human mod with humanized characters and music creation
- [Sprunki Scrunkly](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-scrunkly): Sprunki Scrunkly quirky music creation mod with catchy beats
- [Sprunki OC Real](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-oc-real): Sprunki OC Real music creation game with character design features

## Enhanced & Updated Versions

- [Sprunki Retake Deluxe](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-retake-deluxe): Sprunki Retake Deluxe browser-based music creation and mixing game
- [Sprunki Retake New Update](https://pyramixed.org/sprunki-retake-new-update): Sprunki Retake New Update with enhanced graphics and new missions
